# Schedule 13D / 13G Deadline Calculator

> Free local-first, no-tracking Schedule 13D and 13G deadline calculator for common beneficial ownership reporting scenarios.

## Tool

- [Schedule 13D / 13G Deadline Calculator](https://sec-13d-13g-deadline-calculator.vercel.app/): Estimate common beneficial ownership reporting target dates, copy a source-linked memo, or export a CSV planning row.

## Notes

- Runs entirely in the browser.
- No signup, cookies, analytics, beacons, uploads, external scripts, or browser storage.
- Handles standard U.S. federal holidays and optional extra SEC closure dates.
- Informational worksheet only; not legal advice, securities advice, investment advice, EDGAR validation, SEC affiliation, or an EDGAR filing service.
